attBesluta.text: I have 50 laying chickens and have been raising chickens for over 20 years. I have made and bought different types of laying batteries, but this 10 unit box is easily the best I've ever had. Easy to pick the eggs and for the most part they are clean. Still having a problem with some of the birds using as their bathroom, but as time goes by it is becoming much less of a problem. It was easy to hang on the barn wall with the pre-drilled holes on the back. Moving it to another location will be easy. The 10 unit nesting boxes is perfect for 50 birds. No fighting --- everyone has a spot when they need it. Very easy to clean the boxes by just sliding them out and hosing them down. Highly recommend for the hobby farmer with a small flock. The last nesting box I will be purchasing.

Pełnowymiarowa fortepianowa klawiatura z dynamicznymi klawiszami to największa zaleta tego instrumentu. Zaimplikowane brzmienia instrumentów są całkiem niezłe, zwłaszcza te fortepianowe brzmią całkiem realistycznie. Za tą cenę to naprawdę dobry produkt, nawet profesjonalni muzycy mogą go używać do ćwiczeń, zwłaszcza że jego transport nie będzie stwarzać żadnych problemów. Po połączeniu midi np. z aplikacją typu GSi B3v nieźle imituje brzmienie organów Hammonda. Super.
